name: appealpath
description: AppealPath: a photo of a health insurance denial letter in, one next step out (fix and resubmit, appeal, or urgent review). Prototype, not medical or legal advice. One Cloudflare Worker on the free plan with Workers AI; the app is static assets.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.deploy: npm run check && node scripts/build-client.mjs && wrangler deploy
